Tenancy: Ask agent Let type: Long term Furnish type: Furnished Council Tax: Ask agent PROPERTY TYPE Apartment BEDROOMS 2 BATHROOMS 2 SIZE 940 sq ft 87 sq m 1 +31 Key features 2 Double Bedroom Apartment with Built-in Wardrobe (3rd Floor with Lift)Double Reception Room with Dining Area & Floor to Ceiling Large WindowsFully Fitted Kitchen Integrated with Well-Known Appliances & Breakfast BarLuxurious 2.5 Bathrooms (2 x En-Suite Double Shower Rooms & 1 x Guest WC)Area: 940 Sq Ft / EPC-B / Central Garden View / Utility Room / Long HallwayQuality Furnished / LED Spotlights / Private Balcony (63.5 Sq Ft Additionally)Air Ventilation / Underfloor Heating / Air cooling / Double Glazed WindowsResidents' Swimming Pool, Gym, Meeting Room, Resident's Lounge & Cineplex24 Hr Concierge / 24 Hr Security / Communal Gardens / Bars / Restaurants Description This very stylish 2 double bedroom apartment set in White City Living is situated within the heart of Shepherds Bush. The property enjoys easy access to a number of transport stations, with Wood Lane, White City & Shepherds Bush Underground, Overground & Train Stations being close by (Central, Circle, District, Hammersmith & City Lines, Overground & Southern Trains). There are also plenty of local buses available in the area. Central garden view and set on the 3rd floor spans 940 Sq Ft internally, this impeccable apartment is offered on a furnished basis and has been stylishly decorated throughout with contemporary furnishings. It comprises a large open plan double reception room with dining space and sizable floor-to-ceiling windows affording lots of natural daylight into the property. There's a spacious fully fitted modern kitchen with breakfast bar and well-known built-in appliances, master bedroom with a built-in wardrobe, luxurious en-suite double walk-in shower, 2nd double bedroom with built-in storage spaces, spacious further luxurious 2nd en-suite shower room, internal storage room, utility room, guest cloakroom/WC and a sizable private balcony (63.5 Sq Ft Additionally). The property further benefits include air cooling, underfloor heating, air ventilation system, iDevice controllable home automation system, double glazed windows, hardwood floors in the reception room, luxury comfort carpet in the bedroom, storage room and a good size utility room. The residents also freely enjoy from 24 hours security, concierge, CCTV, lift access, resident's lounge, meeting room, reading area, beautiful swimming pool, spa, top-end fully-equipped onsite gym facility, communal gardens and high-spec cineplex (personal Blu-ray disc on demand & PS4 Pro available). The property is ideally located close to the open spaces of Holland Park & Shepherds Bush Green; ideal for outdoor pursuits. Westfield shopping centre is within walking distance and offers a range of amenities that includes a cinema, designer shops, eateries and children's play activities. Other nearby amenities include a selection of theatres, lively bars, nightclubs, restaurants and cafes.
